docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The first printed edition of the Pāli Milindapañho, the dialogue of the Greek king Menander and the Buddhist elder Nāgasena on self, rebirth and nirvāṇa, edited by Trenckner (London, 1880). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Milindapañho, being dialogues between King Milinda and the Buddhist sage Ngasena · Trenckner, Vilhelm, 1824-1891 · 1880, 450 scanned pages. Published 1880; Vilhelm Trenckner died 1891; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the text of this book is in a script the machine reading of the scans cannot yet give.
